terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Node/Express API on :8787 - mints AssemblyAI Voice Agent tokens (/v1/token), runs the post-hoc compliance report (/v1/analyze-session), and transcribes uploads (/v1/transcribe-upload). Requires the ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY secret to boot.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: React + Vite dev server on :5173, proxies /v1/* to the backend on :8787. Open this URL to use the compliance-report UI.
